### J-1 Full-when-any-fails is attached to the risk-flag clause only
- quote: "no risk flag of auth, money, data-deletion, migration or pii, else `full`."
- situation (correctness): an intake that fails the defect, expected-behaviour or one-module criterion but has no risk flag. The ", else `full`" can be read as applying only to the risk-flag criterion, so the router may fall to `epic` or `full: everything else` by accident. TC-14 cannot catch this, since "full" shares the line with the flag names whatever it refers to.
- fix: move the rule to its own clause, for example "if any of the four fails, `full`", and have TC-14 assert that phrase
